Speculation surrounds potential Modi cabinet reshuffle

Reports indicate a possible reshuffle of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's cabinet, with speculation focusing on potential changes in key ministerial roles. Discussions suggest that Home Minister Amit Shah's influence might increase, while other senior ministers like Rajnath Singh and Nitin Gadkari could be moved. The exact timing and scope of any reshuffle remain unconfirmed.
